name: HYDRA-UMC-TWIN
notes: Established v0: real family-readiness check (`family-status` subcommand) reads each of the 3 real children's own hydra-umc.project.json and reports presence/version/maturity/role. Plus a real state-sync contract (src/contract.rs): a child must be at least `functional` maturity and report a major version no higher than this Twin's verified-compatible ceiling (0 today) before it is treated as sync-ready - an incompatible simulator version or an immature child is refused with a real reason, exposed via the new `family-sync` subcommand. 22 tests. Honest for an integration hub that runs no rendering/physics engine itself - the real Bevy-based engine and MuJoCo/PhysX backend stay future work, blocked on a real GPU/graphics toolchain and the children's own engines maturing.
